text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Sion-san...! I, uh... I have a 
p-present for you...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... There's no way I'd forget... 
After all...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm really grateful. I'm so glad it 
was you, Shion-san...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Shion-san... always understands. When I 
want someone... to listen... Or when I 
want... to be alone, too...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so much, as always! —Here, 
clam pasta! I made it!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Waah... Thank you so much! Purging the 
sand and everything must've been pretty 
tough, huh?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I'm... not very good at cooking, 
so... it took me quite a while...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Even so, you still made it by hand 
for me!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Because you're like that, Cheval-san, it 
makes me feel that I need to do my best 
too.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
As roommates, I'm counting on you from 
here on out, too. ...Hehe!
